metadata.buildMode: node --import tsx source driver; pre-existing compiled engine and projection; source shared reducer
metadata.buildTimeMeaning: oldest/newest filesystem mtimes, not a claimed reproducible build timestamp
metadata.environment: Concurrent repository agents, lint/refactor and build activity are not isolated; no existing app/session is touched
metadata.boundary: Synthetic actor runtime event ports; real driver, engine, in-memory journal, publisher, wire encoder/assembler and shared reducer; no provider or network socket
metadata.journalRetention: Full real InMemoryJournalStore events retained; their event count/JSON bytes and heap cost are included. Publisher retains the production 2000-entry delta window.
metadata.ordinaryActivityDefinition: Same kind/request/completed/tool count signature; changed signature classified separately as boundary activity
metadata.sourceTime: Date.now/new Date at actual emission, preserved by journal envelope and activity; no virtual clock
metadata.transportFlush: continuous >=30ms, replayable >=150ms checked by 50ms source tick; timers may be late under load
metadata.inputScheduling: One wall-clock 50ms batch loops over independently scoped actors; achieved input rate is measured, not an asserted SLO
metadata.sourceModuleFreeze: Modules fixed in each isolated worker ESM cache after import; pre/post directory hashes detect concurrent on-disk changes. Projection/engine dist were not built by this harness. A changed broad app-directory hash is not evidence of a loaded module hot-changing.
metadata.loadedSourceByteHashLimitation: No loader-level byte capture was installed. Source hashes are pre-import disk-tree fingerprints, not a claim of exact bytes for every transitive loaded source module. Dist and shared-protocol tree hashes remained stable across scenarios.
metadata.measurementOverheadIncluded: Process CPU and memory include in-memory journal cloning, publisher retention, projection-byte JSON serialization, physical encoding/assembly, schema parsing, shared client reducer and bounded resource sampling; not an isolated production driver microbenchmark.
metadata.resourceWindow: resources and measuredCounts cover the post-warmup window; counts/projection/cleanup cover setup through termination. Corrected sample additionally provides projectionWindow counters. Peaks are sampled rather than continuous OS maxima.
metadata.performanceCaveat: Initial overdue batches did not yield; failed 256 sample is retained and not a valid product CPU claim. Measurement correction preserves the same input target and safety budgets.

measurementGap.reason: Initial harness only returned these fields after a complete measurement; stored zero means missing, not zero elapsed

correctionReasons: Preserve partial resource samples/counts/wall on budget termination, including failure stage
Yield event loop even for overdue 50ms input batches so driver real timers can fire
